name: Kansas City Treats
old_description: Kansas City Treats, our SQF, Level-2 manufacturing facility, can handle all of your contract manufacturing needs for extrusion and packaging! Whether it’s a one-time or a long-term solution, we’re ready to serve you!
about:
Kansas City Treats operates an SQF Level 2 certified manufacturing facility in Kansas City, Kansas, as a division of J‑Six Enterprises. The plant serves as the company’s primary site for contract production of pet treats, offering a dedicated extrusion and packaging line for third‑party brands.

The facility provides contract extrusion, contract manufacturing, and contract packaging services for pet food brands. Its capabilities cover the full production cycle from extrusion through final packaging, accommodating both one‑off runs and ongoing production programs. The company states it can handle all contract manufacturing needs for extrusion and packaging, whether a one‑time or long‑term solution.

Customers include pet food manufacturers and private‑label brands seeking a certified partner for treat production. The operation focuses exclusively on the pet treat segment, serving companies that require SQF‑level food safety compliance. No specific customer names are disclosed.

The company emphasizes its readiness for flexible engagement, offering both short‑term and long‑term contract arrangements. It positions itself around the quality of its pet treats and the convenience of a single‑source extrusion and packaging operation, without highlighting a specific founding narrative or ownership structure.
